name: EngDesign
description: EngDesign is the first benchmark for holistically evaluating LLMs on real-world, multi-domain engineering design challenges. It comprises 101 design tasks spanning 9 engineering domains with 473 gradable items, using simulation-based evaluation that moves beyond textbook knowledge to assess genuine engineering design capabilities.
typical_sota_score: o3: 34.38% pass rate; no model exceeds 35%
reputation: Accepted at NeurIPS 2025 Datasets & Benchmarks Track; first holistic engineering design benchmark for LLMs
notes: 9 domains: OS Design, Computer Architecture, Control Systems, Mechanical Systems, Structural Design, Digital Hardware, Analog IC, Robotics, Signal Processing; uses SPICE, FEA, MATLAB etc. for verification; avg prompt length 778.71 tokens.
